{{Quote|The Advozse Hegemony is a minor galactic power based on xenophobic expansionism. The Advozsec themselves never troubled us before now.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Hammer Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Advozse Hegemony''' was the [[Speciesism|xenophobic]], expansionist government of the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Hegemony began to expand their influence by conquering neighboring systems using the powerful [[Hammer Station|Hammer]] battle station, but the station was destroyed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Deprived of their primary weapon, the Hegemony retreated from galactic politics and collapsed.
